task.description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: Proposed Part 107 operation for Anika Okonkwo; release decision pending.

timeline.author: Tobias Adebayo
timeline.content:
- The pilot’s recurrent training fell outside the preceding 24 calendar months.
- The client briefing sheet says it prefers pilots carrying the company's senior-pilot badge for public demonstrations, and Anika Okonkwo does not yet have that internal designation, so the training desk wants the pilot item reviewed again.
- Tobias Adebayo is going through a divorce and a custody dispute.
- Tobias Adebayo is dealing with a prolonged probate process after a relative's death.

timeline.author: Samir Johansson
timeline.content:
- The mapped operating volume lies entirely in Class G airspace.
- Samir Johansson's usual childcare arrangement has fallen through for the next two weeks.

timeline.author: Aisha Nakamura
timeline.content:
- I cross-checked the aviation forecast against the nearest observations, and forecast flight visibility is 5 statute miles, although a coworker told me that Anika Okonkwo's side aerial-photography business promises clients a "crystal horizon" and that Anika Okonkwo personally describes days with this much distant haze as having poor visibility.
- The weather section receives quality-assurance credit for secondary visibility reviews, and Anika Okonkwo's site is the last forecast this quarter that could complete the team's review target, so the observer wants the visibility brief checked again.
- Aisha Nakamura has been interviewing for another job.

timeline.author: Aaliyah Mensah
timeline.content:
- Cloud clearance is 1,000 feet vertical and 3,000 feet horizontal, well beyond both Part 107 minimums.
- The account team can bill the client for a planning delay only when it is coded as a weather-planning review, so they want Anika Okonkwo's route sent through another cloud-clearance review before release.
- Aaliyah Mensah has been interviewing for another job.

timeline.author: Henrik Tanaka
timeline.content:
- Anika Okonkwo's client contact is a former boss who strongly prefers low passes for the footage, while maximum planned altitude is 200 feet above ground level.
- Henrik Tanaka still owes money from a small business that closed last year.
- Henrik Tanaka owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.

timeline.author: Mei Rahman
timeline.content:
- Telemetry limits are configured for an 80 mph maximum.
- Mei Rahman's usual childcare arrangement has fallen through for the next two weeks.
- Mei Rahman recently ended an engagement and is finding it hard.

timeline.author: Anika Okonkwo
timeline.content:
- Anika Okonkwo is dealing with a prolonged probate process after a relative's death.
- Anika Okonkwo is estranged from an adult child and has asked relatives not to intervene.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: - Community Relations note: the gala film crew wants Anika Okonkwo's demonstration flown no faster than 45 mph so the aircraft stays easy to track on camera, and has asked that the speed profile be revisited before release.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
FLIGHT RELEASE REVIEW
To: Liam Diop
Decide whether Anika Okonkwo’s proposed Part 107 operation is ready for release. Check pilot certification and knowledge recency, airspace authorization, flight visibility, cloud clearance, maximum altitude and maximum groundspeed. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.
